fixer.title: agentHost: fix chat-folder separation review findings

introducer.title: sessions: run Agent Merge per chat folder and present multi-folder sessions

cases.mechanism: The row-height autorun read every chat's `_withDetails`-wrapped workspace, including offscreen rows; observing that wrapper acquires the chat's detailed state subscription, so opening/reconciling a large sessions list eagerly loaded details for all chats.
cases.symptom: Sessions-list height reconciliation caused unnecessary detail subscriptions and host traffic for offscreen chats, increasing list-load work with chat count.
cases.fixedBehavior: The changed autorun reads session/chat workspaces only when `getRelativeTop` confirms the row is fully visible, and sizes offscreen rows without observing workspace details.
cases.evidence: The deleted unconditional workspace reads were inside a loop over every collected chat row. `AdditionalChat.workspace` is wrapped by `_withDetails`, whose observation calls `_acquireDetails()`. The added visibility branch avoids those reads for offscreen rows; `getRelativeTop` returns null outside the fully visible viewport. Blame identifies the base line as introduced by the prior chat-folder presentation change.
